name: Mahou Shoujo Hanasaki Hotaru Fight!
original_name: 魔法少女 花咲ほたる FIGHT!
source:
There are four episodes in the magical girl Hotaru adventures starting with saving best friend from tentacles humiliation by runaway art teacher Shibamoto.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
本作收录魔法少女小萤冒险故事中的四个篇章。故事伊始，她要从失控的美术老师Shibamoto手中救出最好的朋友，阻止对方利用触手施加的侵害。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
